feedback.finish: Don’t forget that you can always say no when you feel uncomfortable.

atoms.finishSound: Pressure is when someone tries to force you to do something that you don’t want to.

trainers.instruction: Some situations might make us feel uncomfortable. Decide how each situation normally makes you feel.

atoms.a: being forced to eat your lunch really quickly
someone forcing you to give them a hug
learning more about your favourite topic
someone not letting you say no to them

feedback.finish: Being pressured often makes us feel uncomfortable. This can be when someone won’t take no for an answer or makes you feel bad for not wanting to do something.

instruction.text: Read each person’s situation and decide if they are being put under pressure or not.

atoms.a: Greg can’t decide which flavour sweets to choose. His friend Brandon suggests strawberry because he thinks they’re tasty.

feedback.end: Correct! Greg’s friend is giving suggestions to help him. He is not trying to force him to choose something in particular.

atoms.a: Sadie and her friends are walking to the park. Sadie has to stop to tie her laces. Her friends tell her to hurry up, or they will leave her behind.

feedback.end: Correct! Sadie’s friends are trying to make her tie her laces faster by threatening to leave her behind.

atoms.a: Alex doesn’t want to jump off the swings at the park. Their friend says they’re being a baby if they don’t try.

feedback.end: Correct! Alex’s friend is trying to make them do something they’re nervous about by being rude to them.
